source.place: Coefficient quotient, tensor and point-section functor constructions used by the reduction theorem

proof.text: The algebraic closure in the finite-field datum is algebraically closed. The established exactness theorem for point sections supplies the evaluation instances; restriction of scalars is exact. The quotient and tensor functors are the verbatim definitions moved from the original item.

proof_origin.note: Unchanged definitions and exact-section instances factored into the data module for use before assembling the proof. No normalization module is imported or adapted.
